issues.where: the whole interior of the sphere
issues.what: the cottage, tree and pond are smeared into one uniform set of concentric swirl streaks, like a radial-blur filter; at native size (set-B-02 crops 3, 5, 6) there is no surface detail left anywhere inside the glass
issues.fix: keep the swirl to the suspended snow and let the house, tree and pond stay solid under it, with real motion blur falling off with depth, not one even screen-space smear

issues.where: crops 9, 10 and 12, the base and the sand mound
issues.what: thin vertical streak lines cross from the globe down over the carved shells, the plain base and the sand mound with identical spacing and blur, reading as a streak overlay laid on the whole frame rather than falling snow that would be occluded and lit differently
issues.fix: mask the streak layer to the air in front of the scene, vary its size and focus with depth, and let the base and sand occlude it

issues.where: the glowing particles inside the globe, especially set-A-02 crops 1 and 6
issues.what: the fireflies are flat round green discs, mostly one size and one depth, all in focus, none resting on or occluded by branches, walls or the glass
issues.fix: vary their size and blur with depth, dim some behind foliage, and let a few sit on surfaces

issues.where: crop 7, the bright highlight on the glass at the upper right
issues.what: a crisp four-point star flare sits on the rim like a pasted sparkle sticker, sharper than anything else in the frame
issues.fix: soften the flare into the highlight's bloom or drop the star shape entirely

issues.where: crop 1, the apex of the sphere
issues.what: a flat elliptical disc floats inside the glass at the very top of the dome, like an unexplained cap or plug with no attachment
issues.fix: remove it or make it read as a refracted reflection of the base collar

issues.where: crop 12, the sand mound beside the base
issues.what: the mound's crest has a smooth, glossy, whipped sheen with no grain, looking like piped icing or plastic rather than piled sand; the same sheen appears on the mound in set-B-03 crop 12
issues.fix: give the mound a matte granular texture and break up the highlight along its ridge

issues.where: crops 10 and 11, the near bank of the pond
issues.what: a small black beetle-like blob sits on the pale rim at the pond's edge with no legs or shadow, reading as a stray artifact; the same dark speck appears at the bank in set-A-02 crop 5
issues.fix: remove it or resolve it into a real pebble with contact shadow

issues.where: crops 10 and 11, where the water meets the bank
issues.what: the waterline is a single clean painted edge with no wetting, no darkened damp band in the sand and no small lapping variation
issues.fix: darken and saturate a thin wet band of sand at the waterline and ruffle the edge

issues.what: the foliage breaks into repeated rounded broccoli-like clusters of identical size and density, the classic procedural-tree pattern
issues.fix: vary cluster size, silhouette and light penetration so some masses merge and some break apart
